NASAQ brings an implementation mindset to interior fit-out.

Based in Abu Dhabi, we focus on the work that turns interior drawings into finished spaces: coordinating materials, organising site works and executing architectural details.

Our scope spans villa and residential fit-out, offices, commercial interiors, gypsum systems, ceilings, partitions and renovation.

A considered review of your drawings, BOQ and project requirements.

Attention to joints, surfaces, ceiling lines and final finishes.
